description: '''Latin music''' ([[Portuguese language|Portuguese]] and {{langx|es|música latina}}) is a term used by the [[music industry]] as a catch-all category for various styles of Spanish- and Portuguese-language music genres from [[Latin America]], [[Spain]], [[Portugal]], and the [[Latino (demonym)|Latino]] diaspora in [[Latin music in Canada|Canada]] and the [[Latin American music in the United States|United States]], as well as music sung in either language. It may also include music from other territories where Spanish- and Portuguese-language music is made.
